ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4 Playtest adds adaptive burst scheduling and direct profiling of Tick, PathFinder and JobGiver hotspots on top of the V0.3 compatibility-first runtime. Reachability miss caching is now topology-aware. Path/Job state mutation, ReservationManager and whole Pawn ticking remain on the main thread until the worker path engine is validated.
